name: Junior Penetration Tester

fee.note: INE's eJPT page shows no prices. The voucher comes with INE Fundamentals Annual (one year of novice-level training) or the eJPT + Prep Bundle (three months), or can be bought on its own with an active INE subscription; prices appear at checkout.

exam.format: Hands-on practical exam: 45 questions answered from a lab within a 48-hour window. Auto-graded; results usually arrive within a few hours with a breakdown by section.

scope: Entry-level penetration testing: assessment methodologies and information gathering, host and network auditing, host and network penetration testing, and web application testing.
requirements: No formal prerequisites. INE requires an active INE subscription alongside the exam voucher.
ai_policy: Check the current assessment rules. AI-assisted study does not imply permission during the exam.
caveats: INE's certification page gives no price, exam length or passing score. The 45 questions and the 48-hour window come from INE's 26 March 2026 announcement of the updated exam, which grew from 35 questions.
That update added information-gathering and web application testing questions; the certification page still listed web application testing at 15% on 2026-11-17.
Vouchers expire 180 days after purchase. The included free retake must be taken within 14 days of a failed attempt, and both attempts must be submitted before the voucher expires.
INE describes renewal options for the three-year credential but does not detail them on the certification page.

access.retake: The voucher includes one free retake, to be taken within 14 days of a failed attempt and before the voucher expires 180 days after purchase.

prep.note: Linked as 'Start Training' from the eJPT page; needs an INE subscription.
